per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

limits.value: 14x to 20x the public on-demand rate: $0.0828 to $0.1193 an hour for a 1 vCPU and 2 GiB VM
the multiplier is quoted against list prices as of 2026-06-11, so the underlying rate moving changes the price

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider
